translation: English KJV; this is not a POC verification
method: Compared all 52 distinct references with Bible Gateway KJV. Comparison ignores punctuation, capitalization and whitespace. The shew/show spelling variation in Jeremiah 33:3 is accepted.
recommendation: Retain complete KJV wording. Reflections are devotional commentary, not direct Bible quotations.

verses.currentText: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.fullKjvText: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

verses.currentText: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.fullKjvText: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

verses.currentText: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.fullKjvText: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

verses.currentText: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.fullKjvText: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

verses.currentText: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.fullKjvText: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.previousText: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you.

verses.currentText: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.fullKjvText: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.previousText: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope.

verses.currentText: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.fullKjvText: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

verses.currentText: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.fullKjvText: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.previousText: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed.

verses.currentText: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.fullKjvText: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

verses.currentText: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.fullKjvText: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

verses.currentText: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.fullKjvText: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

verses.currentText: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.fullKjvText: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.currentText: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.fullKjvText: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.previousText: My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

verses.currentText: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.fullKjvText: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

verses.currentText: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.fullKjvText: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

verses.currentText: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.fullKjvText: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.previousText: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.

verses.currentText: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.fullKjvText: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

verses.currentText: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.fullKjvText: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

verses.currentText: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.fullKjvText: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.currentText: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.fullKjvText: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.previousText: Be still, and know that I am God.

verses.currentText: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.fullKjvText: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.currentText: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.fullKjvText: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
verses.previousText: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning.

verses.currentText: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.fullKjvText: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.previousText: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?

verses.currentText: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.fullKjvText: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

verses.currentText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.fullKjvText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.previousText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not.

verses.currentText: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.fullKjvText: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

verses.currentText: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.fullKjvText: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.currentText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.fullKjvText: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.currentText: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.fullKjvText: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.previousText: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart.

verses.currentText: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.fullKjvText: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.currentText: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verses.fullKjvText: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

verses.currentText: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.fullKjvText: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

verses.currentText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.fullKjvText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.currentText: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.fullKjvText: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.previousText: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus.

verses.currentText: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.fullKjvText: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.previousText: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee.

verses.currentText: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.fullKjvText: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

verses.currentText: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.fullKjvText: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.previousText: With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

verses.currentText: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.fullKjvText: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

verses.currentText: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.fullKjvText: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and show thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

verses.currentText: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.fullKjvText: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.currentText: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.fullKjvText: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.previousText: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit.

verses.currentText: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.fullKjvText: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

verses.currentText: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.fullKjvText: Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.previousText: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy.

verses.currentText: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.fullKjvText: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

verses.currentText: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.fullKjvText: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

verses.currentText: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live.
verses.fullKjvText: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

verses.currentText: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.fullKjvText: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

verses.currentText: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.fullKjvText: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.previousText: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me.

verses.currentText: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.fullKjvText: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

verses.currentText: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.fullKjvText: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

verses.currentText: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.fullKjvText: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
